We need to propose retrosynthesis route using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order. So first apply template 1914393 to target molecule to get precursors, then apply 1914394 to one of those precursors, then 1914395 to next, etc. Need to construct JSON tree with type mol root (target), children reaction with template_id 1914393, its children are precursor molecules (type mol). Then each precursor may have further reaction nodes.

We need to get the actual precursors by applying templates. Use apply_template tool. First apply template 1914393 to target SMILES COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1.

Let's call apply_template.
